$comment: Subprocessor register. Truthful status only: no BAA is recorded as signed because no executed BAA storage reference exists in this repository. A vendor may be 'signed' only with baaSignedDate and baaDocumentRef. Categories with no chosen vendor use the vendor name 'to be selected'. Retention entries marked verified=false are working assumptions to confirm against the executed agreement or vendor documentation.

vendors.phiDescription: Hosts the application, database, queues, object storage and keys; stores and processes case PHI. Only HIPAA-eligible services may hold PHI.

retention.summary: Customer-controlled. Case PHI is deleted 90 days after case close by our retention job; audit log kept 6 years. Backups and snapshots must expire within the same window.
exceptions: Backup and snapshot expiry must be configured to match the 90-day case PHI window; not yet implemented or verified.

vendors.phiDescription: Model inference over case context that may include PHI. Covered by the AWS BAA only if Bedrock is in scope of the executed agreement.

retention.summary: Working assumption from public AWS documentation: Bedrock does not retain prompts or completions beyond the request and does not use them to train models. Not yet verified against current AWS terms.
exceptions: Abuse monitoring: confirm whether any automated abuse-detection or human review can retain or access prompts and completions, and under what terms.
Model invocation logging, if enabled by us, creates our own PHI-bearing logs that fall under our retention policy.

vendors.phiDescription: Eligibility, authorization and claim-status transactions containing patient and coverage identifiers.

retention.summary: Vendor retention terms not yet obtained. To be recorded from the executed agreement.
